notes:
Inbound SMB lead from product trial. Small engineering team (backend + 2 devs on integrations). Primary ask: replace brittle heuristics with LLM-based ticket summarization + structured output (JSON) for automatic ticket creation in their customers' Zendesk instances. Also interested in tool calling to trigger follow-up actions (assign priority, send templated responses) from within the model.

Key quotes from call: "We need parseable JSON with fields: summary, priority, category, suggested_assignee, confidence_score." CTO wants to keep everything on public cloud for now; no on-prem requirement.

Success criteria for POC: average summarization F1 > baseline heuristics, end-to-end mean latency < 400ms for single-ticket synchronous calls, cost per 1k tickets under $X (discussed cost sensitivity). They asked about streaming for agent UI but will start with synchronous hosted endpoints.

Security: must support SSO for dashboard, audit logs for model calls, retention controls (30/90 day options). Not SOC2 yet but asking roadmap.

Integration notes: will wire function-calling hooks to call out to internal triage microservice (POST /triage). Wants structured output strictly validated - asked whether Redwood hosted API can return deterministic schema or fallback when parsing fails.

Action items: send tailored quickstart with sample function-calling example, include structured output validator snippet (python), provide expected token-cost estimate for their dataset, share security FAQ and SOC2 roadmap.

Quote: "If the POC shows predictable costs and reliable JSON output we can move to paid in 30-45 days."
additional_context: SMB inbound, self-serve signups converted to discovery. Lean towards hosted API due to speed of integration. High interest in tool calling to reduce manual triage. Will evaluate Dedicated only if volume spikes and unit economics favor reserved capacity.
